consequence.statement: A new optional way to set keystore passwords is added; existing passwordSecretRef usage is not stated to change.

original.statement: cert-manager v1.17 adds a literal `password` field for PKCS#12 and JKS keystores on Certificate, mutually exclusive with `passwordSecretRef`.

decision.reason: [ev-4c3d690d4f9d] describes a new optional literal `password` field as an easier alternative to `passwordSecretRef`. It says nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured for existing configurations. The only caution is that the two fields are mutually exclusive, which matters only when someone sets the new field. The CRD diff [ev-60054fcf0986][ev-84061d76ea1b] confirms that `spec.keystores.jks.password` and `spec.keystores.pkcs12.password` were purely added, and the canonical added/none check passed, so kind none (informational) is supported.
